caption_L1: This is a bar plot labeled Latin American passports with the most visa free access to other countries as of July 2020 (visa free score). Visa free score* is defined as a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 150 on the x-axis. Along the y-axis, Country is shown.
caption_L2L3: The countries with the most visa free access for Latin American countries are Argentina, Brazil and Chile. Five countries have a visa free score of over 150 (Uraguay, Mexico, Argentina, Brazil and Chile). The countries with the lowest visa free score in the chart are Peru, El Salvador and Honduras. Peru, El Salvador and Honduras, Paraguay, Panama and Costa Rica have visa free scores of under 150.
